# Config: WorkspaceOverlay

> **Reader:** `WorkspaceOverlayConfig` (`config/WorkspaceOverlayConfig.qml`)
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.WorkspaceOverlay` · category Workspaces · scope look

Workspace overview: The full-screen workspace board (laid out as in Workspaces): drag windows between workspaces, right-drag to resize, middle-click to close.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.


### `WorkspaceOverlay`

- **`WorkspaceOverlay.background`** · string = "color" · enum wallpaper|color
  - Workspace background: What each workspace shows behind its windows.
  - read: `WorkspaceOverlayConfig.wallpaper` (computed) · in: `components/surfaces/workspaces/OverviewGrid.qml`
- **`WorkspaceOverlay.color`** · string = "base01"
  - Background color: The workspaces' color.
  - x-options="colors", x-showIf={"background":"color"}
  - read: `WorkspaceOverlayConfig.color` (computed) · in: `components/surfaces/workspaces/OverviewGrid.qml`
- **`WorkspaceOverlay.dimInactive`** · integer = 50 · 0–90 · %
  - Dim other workspaces: How much darker workspaces other than the active one are drawn.
  - read: `WorkspaceOverlayConfig.dimInactive` (computed) · in: `components/surfaces/workspaces/OverviewGrid.qml`
- **`WorkspaceOverlay.size`** · integer = 85 · 40–100 · %
  - Size: How much of the screen the grid may take.
  - read: `WorkspaceOverlayConfig.size` (computed) · in: `shell/WorkspaceOverlay.qml`
- **`WorkspaceOverlay.backdrop`** · integer = 70 · 0–100 · %
  - Backdrop darkness: How dark the screen behind the grid goes.
  - read: `WorkspaceOverlayConfig.backdrop` (computed) · in: `shell/WorkspaceOverlay.qml`
- **`WorkspaceOverlay.showNumbers`** · boolean = true
  - Workspace numbers: Show each workspace's number in its corner.
  - read: `WorkspaceOverlayConfig.showNumbers` · in: `components/surfaces/workspaces/OverviewGrid.qml`
- **`WorkspaceOverlay.showTitles`** · boolean = true
  - Window titles: Show a window's title while it's hovered.
  - read: `WorkspaceOverlayConfig.showTitles` · in: `components/surfaces/workspaces/OverviewGrid.qml`
- **`WorkspaceOverlay.showHint`** · boolean = true
  - Controls hint: Show the mouse controls under the grid.
  - read: `WorkspaceOverlayConfig.showHint` · in: `shell/WorkspaceOverlay.qml`
